Shanghai Municipal Council Report 1908

Report for the Year 1908 and Budget for the Year 1909
Shanghai Municipal Council, Shanghai, 1909

All tables and lists are transcribed, including small tables set in the text, the staff list, the accounts and the budget (each department or sub-head of the financial statement and budget is a separate table); the prose, the photographs, the plague-rat map, the office organisation chart and the electricity charts are not. Table pages were found from contact sheets by Claude Sonnet 5.5; light pages were read once by Claude Haiku 5.5, dense and wide pages by Claude Sonnet 5.5. Not checked by eye. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. Figures that could not be read are marked [?] (55 cells). The financial statement and budget have their own page numbers, as printed.
